name: Adjourned Agenda and Minutes
agenda_text:
AGENDA FOR THE
SAN DIEGO CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA FOR REGULAR COUNCIL MEETINGS
OF
MONDAY, FEBRUARY 16, 2026
TUESDAY, FEBRUARY 17, 2026
CITY ADMINISTRATION BUILDING
COUNCIL CHAMBERS – 12 TH FLOOR
202 “C” STREET
SAN DIEGO, CA 92101
---------------------------
The City Council meetings of February 16 and February 17 of 2026 have been adjourned, pursuant to the 2026 Legislative Calendar adopted by Resolution 316464 on October 21, 2025.
The next regularly scheduled meeting of the City Council is Monday, February 23, 2026, at 10:00 a.m., and Tuesday, February 24, 2026, at 10:00 a.m.
